newsitem.title: USA: LifeQuest Medical acquires Klein Medical.
newsitem.headline: LifeQuest Medical acquires Klein Medical.

text.p: LifeQuest Medical Inc said on Tuesday it acquired Klein Medical Inc for 600,000 shares of LifeQuest common stock.
Klein Medical, a private company located in San Antonio, Texas, distributes instruments, equipment and surgical supplies used in minimally invasive surgery.
Klein, expected to record sales of $3 million in fiscal 1996, was merged into LifeQuest Medical Inc's newly formed wholly-owned subsidiary, also called Klein Medical Inc.
LifeQuest manufactures and distributes products for minimally invasive surgery.
